t: Snapped Cable Damages Arecibo Observatory Radio Telescope

q.x: Scott Manley posted an excellent video with some discussion of this incident, as well as going over some of the major contributions Arecibo has made to science. [link]

desc: The Arecibo Radio Telescope is one of the most famous astronomical observatories in the world, and for a long time was the world's largest. On Monday night a support cable snapped and fell into the reflector dish, damaging the reflector panels, it also crashed into the side of the gregorian dome which includes the secondard and tertiary reflectors.

recs.stt: Arecibo radio telescope goes dark after snapped cable shreds dish
